identity.name: MRP Advocacy - The Silent Crisis
identity.core_message: Modern Medicine needs Modern Wages. Stop living in the 1950s.

headings.usage: Hero titles, Section headers, Big Stats

grid_system.stats: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8 border-t border-white/20 pt-12

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF3B30] text-white hover:bg-[#D32F2F] rounded-none uppercase font-bold tracking-widest px-8 py-4 text-lg border-2 border-transparent hover:border-white transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white border-2 border-white hover:bg-white hover:text-black rounded-none uppercase font-bold tracking-widest px-8 py-4 text-lg transition-all

cards.style: bg-[#111] border border-white/10 p-8 rounded-none hover:border-[#FF3B30] transition-colors duration-300

visual_enhancers.textures: Use a subtle noise texture overlay on the background (opacity 0.05) to give it a 'printed pamphlet' feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px solid borders for sections. No rounded corners (rounded-none) to maintain the brutalist edge.
visual_enhancers.effects: Use 'glitch' effects on hover for the Minister's quotes.

vintage_hero.treatment: Grayscale, high contrast, maybe a red duotone overlay on hover.

modern_tech_1.treatment: Sharp, clean, cool tones to contrast with vintage.

sections.content: Disclaimer: 'Independent advocacy. Not a union. Not a political party.' Links: Privacy, Contact.

instructions_to_main_agent: TAILWIND CONFIG: Update tailwind.config.js to include these font families and the custom colors.
GLOBAL CSS: Add a noise texture to the body background in index.css.
COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn for the Form/Input but STRIP all default styling. Force 'rounded-none' and 'border-b' styles.
ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure the Red/Black contrast is high enough. Use White text on Red backgrounds, not Black on Red.
TESTING: Add data-testid to the email input ('email-signup-input') and submit button ('email-signup-submit').

do_not: Do NOT use generic 'medical blue' colors.
must_do: MUST use uppercase for all headings.
